title: No-Water Sweet Cabbage & Chicken Broth Soup
originalTitle: No-Water Sweet Cabbage & Chicken Broth Soup
ingredients: 1.5 lbs bone-in or boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 large head green or Napa cabbage (approx. 2 lbs), cored and roughly chopped
4 cloves garlic, smashed & 1-inch piece fresh ginger, sliced
2 tbsp sake or dry white wine + 1 tbsp soy sauce
1.5 tsp kosher salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp toasted sesame oil, and scallions
instructions: Layer half of the chopped cabbage and sliced onions across the bottom of a heavy Dutch oven.

Arrange the chicken thigh pieces, carrots, garlic, and ginger in the middle, then pile the remaining cabbage on top and sprinkle with 1.5 tsp salt and 2 tbsp sake (the salt draws out over 2 cups of naturally sweet vegetable juice — no water needed!).
Cover tightly with a heavy lid and cook over medium-low heat for 30–35 minutes without opening the lid.
Uncover to find the pot filled with crystal-clear, intensely sweet cabbage-chicken broth; finish with soy sauce, black pepper, sesame oil, and scallions.
